name: Nathula Pass (Old Silk Route Indo-China Border)
price_unit: special border permit fee per vehicle
opening_hours: 8:00 AM - 1:30 PM (Closed on Mondays & Tuesdays for general tourists)
rules: Open exclusively to Indian nationals with valid ID and army permit
Elevation 14,140 feet: take slow deep breaths and do not run
visual_features: mountain pass at 14,140 feet with Indian and Chinese military barbed wire border posts, war memorial, and fluttering tricolour flag in the snow
description: Nathu La is a mountain pass in the Dongkya Range of the Himalayas between China's Yadong County in Tibet, and the Indian states of Sikkim. The pass, at 4,310 m (14,140 ft), connects the towns of Kalimpong and Gangtok to the villages and towns of the lower Chumbi Valley.
